VN2V-Weather
	

A multi-weather traffic vehicle re-identification dataset collected in Ho Chi
Minh City, Vietnam, in May 2026, from two paired camera views of the same
traffic scene. Both cameras were positioned on a pedestrian footbridge over a
national highway: one faces approaching traffic (before, front view) and one
faces departing traffic (after, rear view). The observed carriageway carries
traffic in a single direction, so every vehicle crosses the scene in the same
order.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/vehicle-research/multi-weather_traffic_data.
